rich_narrative.summary: Founded in 2002, Al-Maghrib Institute provides accessible Islamic education through <cite id="3">in-person seminars, online courses, and travel-learning programs</cite> across the USA, Canada, the UK, Spain, and Japan. In FY2024, the charity managed <cite id="2">a Total Revenue of $3,845,691</cite> while directing a high percentage of its spending toward educational delivery. Financial filings show <cite id="1">a Program expense ratio of 95.0%</cite>, which exceeds the 75% sector benchmark. However, operational expansion saw a recent shift as revenue declined 8% from $3,216,305 in FY2022 to <cite id="2">$2,959,388 in FY2023</cite>. The organization maintains strong working capital reserves covering over two years of operations, but executive compensation warrants scrutiny as officer compensation represents <cite id="2">$216,728</cite> or 5.6% of overall revenue. Donors can support these ongoing educational initiatives through general charitable giving and <cite id="6">sadaqah</cite>.
